The '''Hoth sentry droid''' was a small, treaded [[Droid tank/Legends|tank droid]] used by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] on [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]]. The [[Droid/Legends|droid]] included a turret that fired [[Missile/Legends|missiles]]. It was operated via remote control by rebel soldiers, and came in green and tan [[Color/Legends|colors]].
